name: Fall from Favor
oracle_text:
Enchant creature
When this Aura enters, tap enchanted creature and you become the monarch.
Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step unless that player is the monarch.
blocked_sentences: Enchanted creature doesn't untap during its controller's untap step unless that player is the monarch.

needs.what: a skip_untap_step static whose hold is lifted per affected permanent when that permanent's controller (the untapping player) is the monarch -- i.e. a static condition `is_monarch` that can name the affected object's controller, read at the untap step
needs.why_existing_wont_do: skip_untap_step with affects {attached: true} covers 'doesn't untap during its controller's untap step', but static_condition_keys (all, any, cmp, counters, exists, has_city_s_blessing, is_attached, is_your_turn, not, top_of_library) has no is_monarch, and `untap_held` reads every skip_untap_step static unconditionally; is_monarch exists only in effect/trigger condition_keys. Dropping the 'unless' clause would make it a permanent freeze (a different, harsher card)
